text:
zoe (Docs): opened a tiny PR to add an 'offline-bundle via proxy' example and an HSM SOCKS fallback note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120. Need infra + sec review.

mike (Eng-Platform): LGTM quick check: include `sha256sum --check` and a short note about preserving client cert Subject when proxying.

carmen (Eng-Infra): Add a one-liner ssh tunnel fallback: `ssh -N -L 15000:hsm.internal:15000 user@gateway` and an nftables passthrough rule for proxy host.

dmitri (Security): Security notes: don't paste keys, recommend ephemeral scoped upload tokens, and a rotate-after-import reminder. Also call out MM TLS issues when LB strips SNI.

rachel (Support): Ops tip: cloud-init sometimes starts proxy late. Suggest `ExecStartPre=/bin/bash -c "for i in {1..30}; do nc -z 127.0.0.1 3128 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1"` on installer unit. I'll verify wording after commit.

ci-bot: CI: build OK, linkcheck: anchor /private/install/offline-upload missing (404).

zoe (Docs): thanks — will replace anchor with #offline-upload-pattern, add the checksum and ssh-tunnel snippet, and push a final commit. Tagging @mike @carmen @dmitri @rachel for quick LGTM. :thumbsup:
